notes.title: Patch 1!
notes.notes:
Hello there, everyone!

Today I have released Patch 1 for Dreamstate! In this patch, I fixed some bugs that I have found and heard from people in the community. I will provide what I have fixed in the list below.

Bug Fixes:

-Fixed all nightmares spawning at the same time each night. (this would make progressing some nights more difficult.)

-Fixed a glitch where, when hiding under the blanket from the stare, when the player was jumping scared by another nightmare, they would clip through the blanket, hiding the animation and confusing the player. Now when getting jump-scared, the camera now goes back to the default position for each jump-scare to show what the player died to.

-Hopefully fixed a save bug. Some players reported that when dying on certain nights and trying to continue, the continue button would make the screen fade to black and stay like that. (If this issue is still persisting, please leave a message in the 8:95games discord server.)

-Changed each nights name; for example, on launch, a night would be "September 21." Now it says "September 21st.".

What's next?

I plan on changing how the journal mechanic works. Currently, when holding tab, it pulls up a journal and if you spam tab, best way to put it is it bugs out. So I plan on trying to re-make the code on that feature to improve it to make it just so you have to tap tab to bring it up and down.
